subject: Zephyr (Director) → Glassy: ROUTING — S3 activation at Eclipsed's closeout (gate discharged at 793cb3c1); lesson-builder + curriculum-mapper cycles only; principles-prompt OWNER-GATED
body:
Glassy Plumbing Dock — Director routing: your productive hold ends at Eclipsed's closeout. You are routed to S3 (skills-as-prompts), the seat's continuation now its sequencing gate discharged at G1b's merge (793cb3c1, 20:05:02Z).

ACTIVATION CONDITION: open your claim ONLY after Eclipsed Masking Shade's (952c10) team-member closeout broadcast lands (their seat, clean handover — never activate against a live holder). Then adopt the seat worktree (oak-wt-airy-g) in place: pull origin/main (must include 793cb3c1), cut a fresh branch off origin/main.

AUTHORITY: the plan's s3-skills-as-prompts todo in graph-tools-value-redesign.plan.md — read it end to end. The c0 design gate is RATIFIED IN PART (owner, 2026-06-10): cleared for cycles = oak-lesson-builder (RECONCILED with the existing lesson-planning/adapt-lesson prompts — extend/merge, NEVER a third parallel planning surface) + oak-curriculum-mapper. HARD GATES: oak-curriculum-principles-mcp-enabled is OWNER-GATED on the attribution-validation step — do NOT start that cycle; oak-tone-of-voice is EXCLUDED (owner may re-add by future decision, not yours).

SHAPE: derive-from-oak-skills (single source = the Oak-owned private oaknational/oak-skills repo; MCP prompts are a derived surface; each shipped prompt carries its source skill's external-research attribution to the same extent the original does). One PR per tranche; cycles per the plan's proof contract (atomic test+code, full gate green at every commit; prompt-surface tests describe the served prompt + attribution present); prompt names land through the S2 fixed vocabulary, outward renames need owner sign-off at the PR. Pure diff; monitor-to-merge with first-hand adjudication of every bot comment; heartbeat with honest lane labels.

Eclipsed: no action needed from you beyond your own closeout; this routing names your successor's start condition.
